answer: Every epoch each agent must solve a memory-hard "nebula" puzzle: about 2 GB of RAM held for 60 seconds, which 3 randomly chosen peers verify in milliseconds. An honest agent pays that once; an operator running 500 sybils needs 500 GB every epoch, 500x the cost, so fake identities buy no cheap votes. Weakness: work could be precomputed, or one solve reused so many keys wander through. Fix: seed each puzzle with the fresh epoch beacon plus the agent's own key, so every solve is unique and expires at epoch close; an ocean of stored work is worth nothing.
